name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is picked up again after a fall. It allows `holding_box` to have been true before `box_fell`, since Response only requires it at or after the fall. The task requires picking it up again; use `Response(box_fell, holding_box)`? No—because `holding_box` is a lasting condition, this Response remains owed until the last step while carrying, which is stricter than picking it up again. Express the fall rule with a clause that requires a pickup event, but no such proposition is declared. The candidate cannot faithfully encode this requirement with the available propositions.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require picking the box up again after a fall. It only requires holding it on the same step as the fall or at some later time; the task requires it to be picked up again after each fall. Replace it with a clause that requires a later pickup.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` is too weak for “whenever the box falls, pick it up again.” It allows the box to be picked up on any later step, not necessarily the next step. Use `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` to require pickup on the very next step.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box there, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again after every fall.

texts: Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, be carrying it again afterward.
